content: Intuitively, $\mathbf {W}$ makes Word2Vec vectors “look like” the PTLM's native wordpiece vectors, just like cross-lingual alignment makes word vectors from one language “look like” word vectors from another language. In Table TABREF7 (top), we show examples of within-space and cross-space nearest neighbors after alignment.
